title: Coxsackievirus A16 2A Protease Binding Assay for Compound Screening
author: Eda Capkin

steps.title: Obtain biotinylated CVA16 2A protease
steps.instruction: Acquire the human Coxsackievirus A16 strain G10 2A protease with a non‑cleavable C‑terminal His‑AviTag (Addgene catalog #228634) expressed and purified as a biotinylated protein.

steps.title: Prepare immobilisation buffer
steps.instruction: Make EV 2A Immobilisation Buffer consisting of 10 mM HEPES pH 7.0, 100 mM NaCl, 0.005 % (v/v) Tween 20, and 0.5 mM TCEP.

steps.title: Immobilise protease on streptavidin chip
steps.instruction: Dilute the protease to 20 µg/µL in the immobilisation buffer, load onto a streptavidin‑coated Creoptix chip, inject for 70 s at a capture threshold of 3000 pg/mm², and keep the flow cell at 25 °C throughout.

substeps.instruction: Dilute protease to 20 µg/µL in immobilisation buffer.
Load streptavidin chip with the diluted protease.
Inject for 70 s, set capture threshold to 3000 pg/mm².

steps.title: Prepare compound dilution series
steps.instruction: Calculate and transfer the required compound volumes to a 384‑well plate: for a 10 µM final concentration transfer 20 nL from a 100 mM stock into 200 µL assay buffer; for 25 µM transfer 50 nL into 200 µL assay buffer. Dilute the 10 µM and 25 µM samples directly with 200 µL EV 2A Assay Buffer; for lower concentrations perform an intermediate dilution before the final 200 µL dilution.

substeps.instruction: Compute transfer volume: (stock concentration × V1) = (desired concentration × 200 µL).
Transfer 20 nL for 10 µM or 50 nL for 25 µM into wells.
Add 200 µL EV 2A Assay Buffer to achieve final concentrations.
For concentrations below 10 µM, execute an intermediate dilution step prior to the final 200 µL dilution.

steps.title: Run RAPID binding assay
steps.instruction: Prepare EV 2A Assay Buffer (10 mM HEPES pH 7.0, 100 mM NaCl, 0.005 % Tween 20, 0.5 mM TCEP, 2 % DMSO). Inject compound samples at concentrations ranging from 0.5 µM to 25 µM at a flow rate of 100 µL/min: 25 s association followed by 90 s dissociation.

steps.title: Analyze sensorgram data
steps.instruction: Record responses on flow channels FC1, FC2, FC3, and FC4; subtract the blank (FC1) from each active channel to obtain FC2‑1, FC3‑1, and FC4‑1; then analyse the processed data using the Creoptix WAVEsystem waveRAPID software.
